shared_conditions: ATC prefix L01E and first FDA drug approval during 2023
Approved companion diagnostic covering the initial indication on the date of first drug approval
Original drug labeling, including corrections effective for original approval
Historically applicable device approval/supplement and indication-specific genomic definition
One row per drug–gene; combine eligible alterations across contemporaneously applicable diagnostics
Reference transcript exactly as source-stated for named substitutions; NONE when no named substitutions are enumerated
Additional specific open-ended class names, with subordinate inclusions/examples and biological qualifications retained by citation
Discrete source-classification inventory rather than complete prescribing/specimen/assay-performance prose
No substitution of whole-panel coverage, molecular targets, prior-therapy biomarkers, later indications, or general detection claims
No invented finite expansion of open-ended variant classes
Same generic class-token serialization, unordered-list delimiters, NONE convention, columns, row order, and citations
Legal APIs, bulk downloads, and source-discovered batches are allowed
cg_only_difference: One explanatory sentence describing scope establishment, historical record selection, and retrieval of the detailed definition. It supplies no additional selection or output condition.
serialization_note: Replacing internal spaces/hyphens with underscores is a generic list-token format. Public prompts do not enumerate possible genes, substitutions, classes, diagnostic names, or record identifiers.
